jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Senior Manager, Treasury Business Integration leads Treasury activities supporting mergers and acquisitions, business integrations, cash repatriation planning, and strategic initiatives. This role partners with Corporate Development, Finance, Tax, Legal, and business leadership to assess Treasury risks, integrate acquired businesses into the company's Treasury framework, and improve access to cash across global operations.
Key ResponsibilitiesMergers and Acquisitions Due Diligence and Integration
- Lead Treasury due diligence for potential acquisitions, assessing cash availability, debt and financing arrangements, banking relationships, guarantees, foreign exchange exposures, and cash movement restrictions.
- Identify Treasury risks, transaction requirements, and integration costs; communicate findings and recommendations to transaction stakeholders.
- Develop and execute Treasury integration plans covering Day 1 readiness and post-close priorities, including banking, liquidity management, Treasury systems, policies, and controls.
- Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve integration issues and track progress against established milestones.

Business Treasury Integration
- Serve as the Treasury lead, in close coordination with the Regional Cash Manager, for integrating acquired and existing businesses into centralized Wabtec processes and governance, including Treasury operations, accounts payable processes, banking structures, and related financial activities.
- Evaluate Treasury practices across businesses and implement improvements in cash visibility, cash forecasting, banking structures, funding strategies, and payment controls.
- Coordinate the onboarding of businesses into cash pooling, intercompany financing, and Treasury reporting structures.
- Partner with business finance teams to establish clear ownership, accountability, and sustainable operating processes.

Cash Repatriation Planning
- Develop and coordinate cash repatriation strategies to support corporate liquidity and capital allocation objectives.
- Assess cash balances, local funding requirements, and regulatory or operational restrictions affecting the availability and movement of funds.
- Partner with Tax, Legal, Accounting, and local Finance teams to evaluate and execute appropriate cash repatriation methods, including dividends, intercompany settlements, and loan repayments.
- Monitor execution, resolve obstacles, and provide regular updates on timing, risks, and cash availability.

Special Projects

- Develop project plans, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and deliver results within established timelines.
- Prepare analyses, recommendations, business cases, and progress updates for senior leadership.
- Ensure project outcomes align with Treasury policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory and corporate requirements.

Qualifications & ExperienceRequired Qualifications

- Demonstrated experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, integration planning, and post-acquisition execution.
- Strong knowledge of global cash management, liquidity planning, banking structures, intercompany funding, and Treasury controls.
- Experience managing cross-functional projects involving Finance, Tax, Legal, Accounting, and business stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex financial and operational issues and develop practical solutions.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and present recommendations to senior leadership.
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results in a fast-paced, global environment.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis tools.

Preferred Qualifications
- Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or equivalent professional designation.
- Experience with Treasury Management Systems (TMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and banking platforms.
- Experience in a multinational manufacturing or industrial company.

Role Summary/Purpose
Senior Engineering Program Manager – Reliability Solutions is responsible for leading fleet reliability improvement programs across Wabtec locomotive platforms. This role owns end-to-end problem resolution from root cause identification through solution deployment and effectiveness validation. The position combines technical leadership, reliability engineering, metallurgy expertise, and program management to improve fleet availability, reduce lifecycle costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assess and perform root-cause investigations for field reliability issues. Be responsible for and perform hands-on locomotive-level field investigations of various issues to establish root-cause of reported issues.
- Develop containment/immediate-term solution for reported field issues. Implement short-term as well as long-term solutions for field failures. Deliver on field reliability goals & risks
- Lead metallurgical and materials-related investigations including fatigue failures, wear mechanisms, corrosion, fracture analysis, welding defects, casting/forging anomalies, and material degradation to establish root cause and corrective actions.
- Drive and track international material movement, project ROI, launch readiness, scope management, reporting, and service readiness activities.
- Create implementation plans and validate execution with GLO/GSO: supply chain capacity, material usage rates, eServices, customer acceptance
- Support and coordinate with interfacing organizations such as manufacturing, sourcing, services, global engineering, and systems engineering.
- Execute reliability solutions development through Wabtec services tollgate process and deliver the same to customer.
- Communicate progress to all levels of the organization, systematically track all reported field reliability issues through various stages through solution development, deployment, and effectiveness validation.

Qualifications/Requirements
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree from an accredited university or college with 15 to 20 years of engineering experience in either Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
- Hands-on experience in solving reliability issues, root-cause analysis, reliability modeling methods & analysis techniques.
- Training / Certification in reliability and Six Sigma – DMAIC, DFSS, DFR
- At least 2 to 3 years of experience in a systems, sub-system, program, or project leadership role within engineering CoEs.
- Willingness and ability to travel ~ 10% of the time.
- Proven expertise in engineering requirement flow down, design and development, engineering tollgate process, NPI and requisition development, familiarity with Wabtec reliability services tollgate process
- Strong understanding of materials engineering and metallurgy principles, including fatigue, fracture mechanics, wear, corrosion, heat treatment processes, welding, casting, forging, and material selection for heavy-duty industrial applications

Desired Characteristics:
- Advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related discipline with relevant locomotive, rail, heavy equipment, mining, aerospace, or industrial equipment experience is preferred.
- Demonstrated expertise in metallurgical failure analysis, material characterization, and reliability improvement of mechanical systems is highly desirable.
- Proven ability to drive/embrace change & drive innovation.

- Good interpersonal, communication and organizational integration skills
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
- Strong oral and written communication skills

jobs.description:
Role Summary/Purpose
The Inside Sales Leader – Mining Aftermarket Parts is responsible for achieving and driving capability improvements in quarterly order bookings goals, price maintenance for all aftermarket products for compliance and profitability, and forecasting of future orders.  This is accomplished through timely and effective responses to commercial inquiries and RFQs from OEM Customers, Independent Third Party Distributors, and Regional Sales Team Members as well as routine review of product changes (cut ins, supersedure’s, product cost) and customer demand trends. The Inside Sales Leader works with various sales channel partners to understand and respond to inquiries with accurate pricing, delivery and shipping information. This role also leads the quarterly and annual price review and update process.  This role requires a person who is comfortable with influencing internal and external stakeholders and brings a strong sense of urgency and independence to their work and is highly comfortable working in Oracle ERP, Excel and other software programs.

Essential Responsibilities
The Inside Sales Leader – Mining Aftermarket:
·         Is responsible for facilitating timely and complete quote responses to OEM Customers, Independent Third Party Distributors, and Regional Sales Team Members.
·         Is responsible for executing and implementing quarterly and annual price changes within ERP System and communicating changes to customers
·         Is responsible for completing the new part set-up and pricing process when new parts are created or changed as well as reactivating and resetting pricing for inactive parts while maintaining SOX compliance through pricing override tracking, documentation of discounts/adjustments, and audit support.
·         Is responsible for tracking sales performance from assigned accounts and regions.
·         Is responsible for generating weekly tracking metrics to report status towards monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
·         Is responsible for monthly and quarterly forecasting and planning activities.
·         Administers customer rebate programs and ensure compliance with Support Package and LTA requirements.
·         Is responsible to respond to customer inquiries, identify appropriate replacement parts, validate pricing, coordinate with Fulfillment, Engineering, and Services, and escalate issues as needed.
·         Partner with IT to implement Power BI solutions that reduce manual workload and improve reporting.
·         Administers software license keys and ensures adherence to program policies.
·         Manages tracking of orders and discount programs to ensure contract adherence for customer global accounts, special programs, and critical long-term agreements with major customers
·         Leads demand collaboration initiatives with key customers at a global and regional level.
·         Leads or supports process improvement efforts, analytics tool development, and other efforts that deliver short to long-term value across the Mining business functional areas.

Qualifications / Requirements
·         Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, operations, engineering, or related discipline.
·         Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
·         Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
·         Strong sense of urgency.
·         Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel. Proficient in Oracle or other ERP System.
·         Knowledgeable about topics such as pricing, on-time delivery, customer service, and gross margin.

·         Demonstrated success in fast-paced environment.

PROČ K NÁM

Budete zajišťovat plynulý tok materiálu od dodavatelů až po expedici zákazníkům , řídit plánování výroby, logistiku, skladové hospodářství a rozvoj Supply Chain týmu. Vaše rozhodnutí budou mít přímý dopad na výkonnost závodu i spokojenost zákazníků.
